module autovcoder_126446 (  
    input wire [15:0] plaintext,  
    input wire [15:0] exponent,  
    input wire [15:0] modulus,  
    input wire clk,  
    input wire start,  
    output reg [15:0] ciphertext,  
    output reg done  
);  
    reg [15:0] base;  
    reg [15:0] result;  
    reg [15:0] exp;  
    reg [3:0] state;  

    parameter IDLE = 4'b0000,  
              COMPUTE = 4'b0001,  
              DONE = 4'b0010;  

    always @(posedge clk) begin  
        case (state)  
            IDLE: begin  
                if (start) begin  
                    base <= plaintext;  
                    result <= 16'd1;  
                    exp <= exponent;  
                    state <= COMPUTE;  
                    done <= 0;  
                end  
            end  
            COMPUTE: begin  
                if (exp > 0) begin  
                    if (exp[0] == 1) begin  
                        result <= (result * base) % modulus;  
                    end  
                    base <= (base * base) % modulus;  
                    exp <= exp >> 1;  
                end else begin  
                    ciphertext <= result;  
                    state <= DONE;  
                end  
            end  
            DONE: begin  
                done <= 1;  
                state <= IDLE;  
            end  
        endcase  
    end  
endmodule
